description: Defines the WebSocketEndpointLockManager class for managing WebSocket connection locks, including nested classes Waiter and LockReleaser, and methods for locking, unlocking, and testing lock states.

classes.name: WebSocketEndpointLockManager
classes.description: Manages WebSocket endpoint locks to enforce connection throttling as per RFC6455 4.1.2.

classes.name: WebSocketEndpointLockManager::Waiter
classes.description: Interface for objects waiting for an endpoint lock.

classes.name: WebSocketEndpointLockManager::LockReleaser
classes.description: RAII class that releases the lock on destruction.

methods.name: LockEndpoint(const IPEndPoint& endpoint, Waiter* waiter)
methods.description: Attempts to lock an endpoint; returns status code.

methods.name: UnlockEndpoint(const IPEndPoint& endpoint)
methods.description: Releases the lock on an endpoint asynchronously.

methods.name: IsEmpty()
methods.description: Checks if the lock info map is empty.

methods.name: SetUnlockDelayForTesting(base::TimeDelta new_delay)
methods.description: Sets delay for unlocking, for testing purposes.
